entities.summary: Josefina Alys Hermes de Vasconcellos was an English sculptor who worked in bronze, stone, wood, lead and perspex. She was at one time the world's oldest living sculptor. She lived in Little Langdale, Cumbria, much of her working life. Her most famous work includes Reconciliation ; Holy Family ; Mary and Child ; and Nativity at St Martin-in-the-Fields.
